blocking_conditions: Evidence does not support a recorded specialist claim. code-security-reviewer SEC-R10-01 and SEC-R10-02 are PASS with exit_status 1, and the record and probes README attribute the non-zero exit only to the obsolete round-9 S11 assertion ('28 pass, 1 fail'). Both probe logs (probe-run1-lang-unset.log and probe-run2-lang-c-utf8.log, lines 128-131 and 171) show a second failure: 'Failed Suites 1', zz-sec-r10-probe.test.ts 'Error: Hook timed out in 30000ms' at afterAll(() => api.close()), 'Test Files 2 failed (2)'. No record discloses or explains it.

Untriaged product defect in the DG2 evidence-upload scope (REQ-S13-012, REQ-S16-013), reproduced by the auditor. After a 30 MiB CHUNKED over-limit upload to uploadEvidenceContent over a real socket, the API answers 413 evidence.too_large without closing the connection. It still holds the socket about 65 s after the client destroyed it, and app.close() (also run by src/main.ts on SIGTERM) completes only after about 65 s. This is independent of the Content-Type spelling and also present at the round-9 candidate 041478cb, so it is not a BE15 regression. It has no finding ID, severity, mandatory classification, repair or acceptance. A specialist (code-security-reviewer) must triage it. If raised, it must be repaired and verified by a non-author, or, only if Low and non-mandatory, accepted as an observation by a specialist and by the release-auditor with rationale and owner. The auditor cannot waive it.

The gate validator rejects the closure of F-DG2-206 (Low, non-mandatory): 'verified by its own owner (qa-verifier)'. findings.json records owner=qa-verifier and verification.by_role=qa-verifier, while stages.json attributes fix ee46813 to the orchestrator. Either correct the ownership record or obtain a verification by a non-owner.

Consequently, code-security-reviewer's round-10 PASS cannot be relied on as a complete record of its checks. A new review round with corrected or complete evidence is required before re-audit, because round-10 records are write-once.
notes: DG2 engineering delivery gate only. It grants no real business, Finance or IT approval, and implies nothing about product gates G1-G6. Every other audit condition holds: identity, DG1 historical, register, provenance, 28/28 findings CLOSED_VERIFIED with correct ancestry (F-DG2-350/351 validly closed on this candidate), 32/32 requirement coverage, D-059 to D-070, residuals D-057/D-058/D-049 on their verified surfaces, and 0 BLOCKED specialist checks. Gate BLOCKED until the conditions above are resolved and a fresh audit passes.
